samples.question: Follow the connected ribbon from the red ring to the gold triangle. Read its 25 panels in travel order and place them left-to-right in five rows of five. Which dark-panel pattern needs the fewest panel changes: corner (a full edge row plus an end column), tee (a full edge row plus the center column), or chevron (two diagonal arms meeting at a tip)? Rotations and reflections keep the same name; answer ambiguous for a tie.
